llm_synthesis.top_priority: The Fixed Income pipeline has never run despite FI agents existing, leaving $30,000 of allocated capital idle and an entire asset class uncovered.
llm_synthesis.themes: Multiple stale or never-run pipelines, silent agents, and unreviewed positions point to a systemic scheduling/orchestration failure rather than isolated agent defects.
llm_synthesis.synthesis: The most acute operational gap is the Fixed Income pipeline, which has never executed, but the pattern of stale pipelines, silent agents, and unreviewed positions suggests a firm-wide orchestration breakdown that should be diagnosed at the root. Separately, the board has not convened in 999 days despite 2 open IRM flags and an elevated CRO posture, which is a governance failure requiring an immediate board meeting. Recommend convening the board now to address the IRM flags and authorizing an engineering review of the pipeline scheduler.
